### ① Derived judgments

Each key had one reader, the `extraSegments.push` in `AppHeader.tsx`, and that reader leaves in the same diff, so `check:i18n-keys` (every `t()` call-site key exists in `en`) and `check:i18n-drift` (all-locales parity, "2 removed") both stay green on the head. No other `console.breadcrumb.*` key moves (`system`, `marketplace`, `settings`, `apps`, `profile`, `approvals`, `aiApprovals`, `auditLog` all still read at `AppHeader.tsx:109-115, :438`). Right.

The precedent changeset for `console.breadcrumb.pages` (PR objectui#12247, PASS `6125264132`) carried exactly this shape. Right.

The diff removes exactly two `extraSegments.push` calls (`AppHeader.tsx:398` and `:425` at base) and adds comments; the page, system and object branches are byte-identical.
